messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Increased OOM and 5xx rate on hosted runtime (kvcache). Alert triggered by rate > 4% errors for /v1/generate across prod region us-west-2. Possible cause: sudden spike in very long prompts causing KV cache growth.

Dani (oncall): I’m on it, paging the runtime team. Can someone grab logs and recent deploys?

mike (runtime): Noted. I’m pulling KV cache metrics and continuous-batching metrics now. Seeing multiple hosts with kvcache.size >> baseline and steady increase in kvcache.page_faults.

sana (eng-sre): Adding traces — looks correlated with a traffic surge from a single keyspace (customer_x). Their requests have multi-100k token prompts (likely concatenated transcripts).

leo (svc-sre): Reached out to partner SRE to confirm. Customer support, can you confirm if they started a bulk ingestion job?

customer-support: Reached out to the customer — they confirm a new ingestion job started ~20m ago. They didn’t expect it to go that long. Impact: some of their requests getting 502/503s, other customers seeing mild latency increase.

Dani (oncall): Triage plan: (1) short-term mitigation to stop OOMs and restore service; (2) targeted rollback/hotfix; (3) post-incident customer follow-up and limits. Volunteers for steps?

mike (runtime): I can push hotfixes. Short-term: disable prefix prefetch and reduce continuous batching max_tokens to avoid huge batched KV windows. Also force-evict extremely long contexts from kvcache.

sana (eng-sre): I’ll update alert thresholds and start a controlled throttle on that customer’s keyspace (rate limit + cap on context length).

product-ops: We should also prepare a customer message template explaining the limits and ask them to stagger their ingestion.

Dani (oncall): Actions now. Mike, Sana, Leo — coordinate. I’ll coordinate external comms.

mike (runtime): Executing mitigation steps. Pushing runtime config change (hotfix) to hosted pool alpha -> beta -> prod. Patch: disable prefetch and set kvcache.max_entries=200000 and continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=2048.

deploy-bot: deploy started by mike to runtime/hosted-prod (hotfix/kvcache-2026-03-15)

mike (runtime): Logs from host i-07ab shown below — evictions spike after change, kvcache size stabilizing:
```
[03-15T17:42:10Z] kvcache.size=2.1e6 entries (pre)
[03-15T17:43:05Z] applied hotfix: prefetch=off, max_entries=200000, max_batch_tokens=2048
[03-15T17:44:12Z] eviction.run=1, evicted=1.9e6 entries
[03-15T17:45:30Z] kvcache.size=120k entries (stabilized)
```

sana (eng-sre): I just applied an emergency rate limit on customer_x: per-minute token cap 200k and max_context_tokens=65536. That should prevent recurrence while they rework ingestion.

leo (svc-sre): Confirming metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 4.7% to 0.4% over last 6 minutes. Latency back within SLO for most customers.

customer-support: Customer_x acknowledged throttling and will pause ingestion. They requested temporary backfill guidance.

Dani (oncall): Good. Assessing customer impact: one customer (customer_x) saw ~30% of requests fail during incident window ~17:22–17:46 UTC. Broader customer latency degradation ~2–5% for 25m. No data loss reported.

product-ops: Drafting message: short incident summary + recommended max context sizes + steps to move to chunked uploads. Will send after we finalize timeline.

mike (runtime): Propose follow-up changes before we reopen prefetch: (1) add context-length-aware prefetch limits, (2) per-keyspace kvcache quotas, (3) continuous-batching soft-limits to avoid O(n^2) KV growth for huge prompts.

sana (eng-sre): Agree. Also suggest adding an automatic eviction policy that targets very old prefix entries and unnatural growth patterns.

Dani (oncall): Handoff to post-incident: owner mike for runtime fixes, sana for alert+rate-limit docs, product-ops for customer comms, leo for rollout plan. Who wants postmortem?

mike (runtime): I’ll draft the postmortem with timeline and config diffs.

product-ops: I’ll coordinate customer message and backlog item for UX to show context usage warnings.

Dani (oncall): Closing on-call. Current status: degraded -> recovered. Monitor for 2 hours, reopen if errors > 1% sustained. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy completed to runtime/hosted-prod (hotfix/kvcache-2026-03-15) — duration 3m12s

mike (runtime): Follow-up next steps:
- create kvcache per-keyspace quota PR
- prefetch feature flag: add context-length guard
- add metric: kvcache.per_keyspace_entries and alert at 90th percentile growth

sana (eng-sre): I’ll update the incident dashboard and add the customer_x tag to allow retrospective analysis.

product-ops: Customer message queued. Will be sent after PM review.

Dani (oncall): Thanks team. Re-opening channel for any regressions. I’ll turn this into a postmortem stub and assign owners.

mike (runtime): assigning ticket INF-2248 -> contains config diffs, logs, and remediation checklist.

customer-support: Noted, will follow up with customer_x once message is approved.

sana (eng-sre): Monitoring shows stable kvcache size and low eviction rate. Marking incident mitigated.

Dani (oncall): Incident mitigated at 17:46 UTC. Last update at 17:55 UTC. Closing thread, postmortem and action items will be in INF-2248. :white_check_mark:
